id.description: A unique identifier for the location.

name.description: Group calling line ID name. By default the Org name.

phoneNumber.description: Directory Number / Main number in E.164 Format.

type.description: Webex Calling location only suppports `TRUNK` and `ROUTE_GROUP` connection type.

id.description: A unique identifier of route type.

connection.description: Connection details are only returned for local PSTN types of `TRUNK` or `ROUTE_GROUP`.

subscriptionId.description: PSTN connection ID given for locations with a PSTN subscription.

externalCallerIdName.description: External Caller ID Name value. Unicode characters.

userLimit.description: Limit on the number of people at the location. Read-Only.

pAccessNetworkInfo.description: Emergency Location Identifier for a location. Set this field to provide the SIP access network information to the provider which will be used to populate the SIP P-Access-Network-Info header. This is helpful to establish the location of a device when you make an emergency call.

outsideDialDigit.description: Must dial to reach an outside line, default is None.

enforceOutsideDialDigit.description: True when enforcing outside dial digit at location level to make PSTN calls.

routingPrefix.description: Must dial a prefix when calling between locations having same extension within same location.

defaultDomain.description: IP Address, hostname, or domain. Read-Only.

chargeNumber.description: Chargeable number for the line placing the call. When set and useChargeNumberForPChargeInfo is true, all PSTN calls placed from this location will include a P-Charge-Info header with this specified number in the SIP INVITE.

useChargeNumberForPChargeInfo.description: Indicates whether the location's chargeNumber (if set) is enabled for use as the P-Charge-Info header in the SIP INVITE for all PSTN calls placed from this location. The field is returned as true if the location's PSTN allows use of the chargeNumber.
